steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Once upon a time, on a well-lit night, a little mythical critter symbolizing luck got separated from its family.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The little critter wandered high and low searching for its family. It traveled a long, long way, and finally came to a strange city.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: But the city was so huge. Where can it find clues about its family?

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The little critter cried out in sadness, which caught the attention of a bunch of strange ducks.

steps.speaker: Strange Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack! Quack quack quack quack quack!
(Ignore the girl! Continue with Operation Stella Hunt!)

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hey, what are you doing? Don't touch Stella! Go away!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: If you bully Stella, I'll get really angry!

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Ha...ha... then the ducks say, you sound really weird. I could tell you're not a local right away.

steps.speaker: Strange Duck
steps.content: You must be a spy from the Outlands!
